summary: Frontend-only regression of /admin/implant-compare (iter-442 fix). Exercised all 4 required component chips (final_abutment, healing_abutment, multi_unit_abutment, ti_base) plus cover_screw regression and student access. Every pill row (diameter/gh/angulation/platform) toggles filter correctly, 'Showing X of N' shows X>=1 in every case (16/16 first-pill taps), untoggle restores baseline, chip-switch clears filter. Multi-dimension stacking on MUA (GH 3 -> Angulation 17 -> Diameter 3.3) yields 23 -> 8 -> 1 cards without hitting 'No systems match' (faceting works). Faceting verified: after selecting GH pill on MUA, three diameter pills (5, 5.4, 5.65) disappear from the diameter row. Platform pill rows on all 4 required chips contain zero pure-number testids (compare-pill-platform-<digits>). Cards after filtering actually contain the selected spec (23/23 MUA cards have GH=3; 19/19 FA cards have diameter 4.5). Cover_screw chip renders 57 cards without crash. Student Gaurav.pandey can open the page without a red screen (backend GETs succeed for students). Overall PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: implant-compare.tsx uses numList()/num() normalisation and platList() bare-number filter as advertised (lines 60-77). Faceted summary computed correctly via computeFaceted() (lines 175-183). No functional issues found.

Minor: The at-a-glance card is only visible when hasSummary is true (line 273), so for component types with zero numeric/platform data (rare) the summary card is hidden but chip switching and card listing still work (verified on cover_screw where summary happened to render).
Non-blocking: console warns about deprecated 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' — global React Native web wrapper warnings unrelated to this screen.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (13/13 functional checks after fixing test-side regex; 40/40 pill toggle flows across 4 chips)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Compare pill filter flow is fully green after iter-442. Selectors used: compare-chip-<type>, compare-pill-<kind>-<value> (kind in diameter|gh|angulation|platform, value is raw number like 3, 4.5 or platform code), compare-summary-title, compare-clear-filter, compare-card-<key>, compare-at-a-glance. Title regex must be case-insensitive: 'Showing X of N systems' vs 'At-a-glance — most common across N systems' (rendered uppercase via textTransform).
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — verifying an already-applied fix. Verified: pills faceted so stacking never produces zero results (MUA GH3 + Ang17 + Diam3.3 = 1 card); numeric normalisation working (float pills like 4.5 and 3.8 match rows regardless of number-vs-string storage); Platform row excludes bare numeric strings (previously mis-tagged diameters like 3.3/4.3 no longer appear as platforms); summary header switches between at-a-glance and 'Showing X of N systems' when a filter is active.
